# Foldora AI

> Foldora is a Windows and macOS desktop app that categorizes and renames files locally. Users can review proposed changes before applying them. Verified supported systems: Windows 10, Windows 11, macOS.

## Official product facts

- Canonical website: https://foldoraai.com/
- Product category: Local AI file organizer and file renaming software
- Supported platforms: Windows 10, Windows 11, macOS
- Current lifetime price: USD 14.99
- Official purchase page: https://computora.gumroad.com/l/foldora
- Publisher: Computora AI (https://computoraai.com/)
- Official GitHub organization: https://github.com/foldora-ai
- Support: team.foldora@outlook.com
- Privacy model: File analysis and organization run locally; files do not need to be uploaded to a cloud organizer.
- Safety model: Users preview proposed folders and filenames before applying changes.

- [AI File Organizer for Windows](https://foldoraai.com/ai-file-organizer/): Organize, categorize, and rename files on Windows with private local AI. Preview every proposed folder and filename before applying changes.
- [Best File Organizer for Windows](https://foldoraai.com/best-file-organizer-windows/): Compare AI, rule-based, and manual file organization for Windows. See which approach fits Downloads cleanup, renaming, privacy, and large folders.
- [How to Organize Files Automatically on Windows](https://foldoraai.com/organize-files-windows/): Build a practical Windows file system for Downloads, Desktop, Documents, and project folders, then automate repeated sorting and renaming.
- [AI File Organizer for Mac](https://foldoraai.com/organize-files-mac/): Organize files on Mac with local AI. Preview suggested folders and filenames before changing Downloads, Desktop, Documents, or project folders.
- [How to Organize Thousands of Files](https://foldoraai.com/organize-files-automatically/): A safe workflow for categorizing, renaming, and archiving thousands of files with previews, small batches, and a structure built for retrieval.
- [How to Rename Files Automatically](https://foldoraai.com/rename-files-automatically/): Automatically rename PDFs, invoices, screenshots, and work documents with readable patterns while keeping previews and local processing.
- [File Organization for Students](https://foldoraai.com/use-cases/students/): Organize course readings, lecture slides, assignments, notes, and screenshots with a semester system that remains easy to archive.
- [File Organization for Freelancers](https://foldoraai.com/use-cases/freelancers/): Organize briefs, contracts, invoices, source files, deliverables, and feedback with a repeatable client folder lifecycle.
- [File Organization for Researchers](https://foldoraai.com/use-cases/researchers/): Organize literature, protocols, data, analysis, figures, manuscripts, and administrative records without replacing specialist research tools.
- [File Organization for Accountants](https://foldoraai.com/use-cases/accountants/): Organize client records, invoices, statements, tax documents, workpapers, and exports with year, entity, status, and retention controls.
- [Foldora vs Hazel](https://foldoraai.com/alternatives/hazel/): Compare Foldora and Hazel on Mac: local AI suggestions with a preview versus persistent folder rules and deeper macOS automation.

- [Foldora vs Microsoft Power Automate](https://foldoraai.com/alternatives/power-automate/): Compare a focused local AI file organizer with Microsoft's broader workflow automation platform for desktop, cloud, and business processes.
- [Automatic vs Manual File Organization](https://foldoraai.com/alternatives/manual-organization/): Compare automatic and manual file organization by setup time, review, control, scale, consistency, and the types of files each method handles best.
- [File Organization for Consultants](https://foldoraai.com/use-cases/consultants/): Organize consulting proposals, statements of work, research, meeting notes, deliverables, invoices, and client handoffs with a repeatable system.
- [File Organization for Small Businesses](https://foldoraai.com/use-cases/small-business/): Organize small-business finance, operations, sales, vendor, employee, and project files with a practical local folder and naming system.
- [Foldora vs NudgeFile](https://foldoraai.com/alternatives/nudgefile/): Compare Foldora and NudgeFile for Windows file organization, including review-first cleanup, monitored folders, renaming, local AI, and workflow scope.
- [Foldora vs Sortio](https://foldoraai.com/alternatives/sortio/): Compare Foldora and Sortio for Windows file organization, privacy, previews, renaming, and ongoing automation before choosing a workflow.
- [Best Sortio Alternative for Windows](https://foldoraai.com/alternatives/sortio-alternative/): Looking for a Sortio alternative on Windows? Compare Foldora's local, review-first file organization with prompt-based automation.
